summary: Bluerock Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company, filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, confirming consummation of its initial public offering of 17,250,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including a fully exercised 2,250,000-unit over-allotment option, generating gross proceeds of $172,500,000. Simultaneously, the company completed a private placement of 5,812,500 warrants at $1.00 per warrant to its sponsor and underwriter representative, raising $5,812,500. Total proceeds of $173,362,500, or $10.05 per unit, were placed in a U.S.-based trust account, including a $6,037,500 deferred underwriting commission. The filing includes an audited balance sheet dated September 28, 2026.
